description: This file contains helper functions for the Goteo project, including logging formatting, IP retrieval, SQL debugging, date and amount formatting, URL security, base64 encoding, and class name conversion.

methods.name: global_formatter
methods.description: Formats log records by adding server, session, GET, POST, and cookie data to the record's extra field.

methods.name: monolog_level
methods.description: Converts a string log level to Monolog's Logger constant.

methods.name: myip
methods.description: Retrieves the client's IP address, considering proxies and forwarding headers.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Prints a human-readable trace of a resource or variable.

methods.name: sqldbg
methods.description: Replaces parameter placeholders in an SQL query with actual values for debugging purposes.

methods.name: is_assoc
methods.description: Checks if an array is associative.

methods.name: date_interval
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two dates in specified format.

methods.name: date2time
methods.description: Converts a date string to a UNIX timestamp.

methods.name: date_valid
methods.description: Validates if a date string is a valid date.

methods.name: array_empty
methods.description: Checks if all elements in an array are empty.

methods.name: date_formater
methods.description: Formats a date into a language-dependent string, optionally including time.

methods.name: amount_format
methods.description: Formats a monetary amount according to project currency settings.

methods.name: euro_format
methods.description: Formats a number as a Euro currency string.

methods.name: sec
methods.description: Ensures a URL uses HTTPS if in a secure environment.

methods.name: mybase64_encode
methods.description: Encodes a string in base64 with URL-safe characters.

methods.name: strtoCamelCase
methods.description: Converts a snake_case string to CamelCase.

methods.name: get_public_class_vars
methods.description: Returns public class variables of a class.

methods.name: get_public_object_vars
methods.description: Returns public object variables of an object.
